excerpt: Payment confirmed on-chain, webhook received, order logged, delivery email sent — all within 30 seconds. The fully automated sovereign commerce pipeline.

content.text: Manual order fulfillment is a trap that most creators do not recognize until it breaks at exactly the wrong moment. It functions at five sales per month. It breaks when you are asleep and a buyer in a different timezone completes a purchase and waits eight hours for a download link that should have arrived in 30 seconds. It breaks when a webhook notification gets buried in your inbox. It breaks under volume in ways that destroy buyer trust that took months to build. The automated pipeline that COREMERCH deploys eliminates every manual step permanently. When a buyer pays in crypto, NOWPayments detects the on-chain transaction and fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-explained-digital-7|Google Apps]]-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-what-actually-9|google]] Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-which-architecture-actually|COREMERCH guide to supabase]] or Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email via Resend or Gmail — all within 30 seconds of payment confirmation.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation is a custom backend solution built using Google's low-code platform, designed to process orders in under 30 seconds without relying on Stripe or other blocked payment gateways. This infrastructure gives digital creators the sovereignty to control their own commerce stacks, bypassing platform restrictions and limitations. By automating manual fulfillment processes, creators can focus on growth, customer satisfaction, and revenue, not tedious administrative tasks.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture leverages Google Apps Script as the custom backend logic, interacting with NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This combination enables seamless automation of digital product delivery, eliminating manual intervention and reducing fulfillment times. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle webhook events, triggering delivery emails and updates, while NOWPayments' 0.5% fee and 300+ cryptocurrency support make it an attractive solution for creators seeking flexibility and control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is designed for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment gateways are restricted or unreliable, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and others. By providing a sovereign commerce stack, COREMERCH empowers these creators to monetize their digital products without dependence on third-party platforms, ensuring they can scale their businesses with confidence and control.
Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments is made possible by integrating NOWPayments with Google Apps Script.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers is the backend engine in Stack 02 deployments. It runs serverless JavaScript at the edge — code that executes in response to HTTP requests, including the incoming NOWPayments webhook. The free tier provides 100,000 requests per day, which is sufficient for the sales volume of most individual digital product sellers. Workers has no server to manage, no runtime to configure, and no infrastructure to maintain. It scales automatically and is globally distributed — the same code runs in data centers close to wherever the request originates.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), deploy it on your chosen platform, configure NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. By following these steps, you can automate digital product delivery, reduce manual errors, and increase customer satisfaction, giving your business the sovereignty it deserves.
